critical_concerns.description: The requested WT-D20260512_002 alpha_package, risk_package, optimization_package, challenge notes, weights.csv, stage artifact dirs, alpha_scores.parquet, and covariance.parquet are absent, blocking independent verification.

Current book_state records production_promotion_BLOCK=true, AX-008 3/3 mandate unmet, 9 grace clauses binding, and deployment_suspended retain; the draft flips this to READY through mandate language rather than completed evidence.
The draft claims AX-008 2/3 floor with Codex pending, but current-cycle Codex is not PASS and the applicable PD34 mandate requires 3/3 before production promotion.

The draft inherits or references full TO 759.3%/yr justification, which exceeds the base hard turnover cap of <600% annual; a monitoring waiver cannot silently convert a hard fail into production READY.

The observable 20260512 production weights are a 4-sleeve snapshot, not a WT-local walk-forward single-sleeve AR_on_M4 weights.csv, so max_names, universe, liquidity, turnover, PIT lag, and per-date cap compliance cannot be verified.
WT-RES confirms Layer 4 SR/MDD reproduction, but current-WT Harvey 5-spec, DSR trial count, same-period baseline parity, and Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined decomposition are not supplied.
